title: Agent libOS local GUI API contract subset v2
description: Machine-readable same-build schema registry for the snapshot's top-level structure and non-secret TaskRun launch availability, process identity/state, content-free LLM call summaries, redacted Durable Task Run summaries/details, JSON error envelopes, and explicit-confirmation mutation payloads. The document root deliberately rejects instances: validators must select one of the named $defs entry points with a JSON Pointer fragment. Snapshot collection item semantics outside process, LLM call, and Task Run state remain renderer/server implementation details. This is not a complete public REST/OpenAPI specification.

workflow.run.conditional: Only workflow requests classified as high-risk require confirmed=true.

mcp.prompt.confirm.conditional: confirmed=true plus the Runtime-issued expected_preview_sha256 are required only when accepting the exact preview as untrusted user context.

continuation.respond.human_request_settlement: Runtime settles the bound durable HumanRequest before continuing; responses are never forwarded directly.

remote_task.update.human_request_settlement: Runtime settles the bound durable HumanRequest before updating; responses are never forwarded directly.

x-agent-libos-definition-usage.root_validation: The registry root is not an instance schema and always rejects. Select a definition explicitly.

inert_url.description: Untrusted display-only Provider text. Clients must never fetch or open it automatically.

oneOf.description: Diagnostic stale-execution takeover projection; not independent TaskRun resume authority.
